author: JstrJad
body: Hello, I've been ban for fly hacking. It's true, I had a fly mod but in the past two months I've since gotten rid of it. Like I said, it has been two months and I don't know how long my punishment should be, but I assure you, I'll not be using any fly hacking in the present or future. This is my favorite server to play on and I apologize.Thank you for reading and sorry for disobeying the rules.  Sincerely, JstrJad

title: Fly ban appeal

replies.author: Posighdun
replies.body:
Hello JstrJad,

You need to wait a bit longer in order to appeal your fly hacking ban. Try appealing within the next 4-6 months. This appeal is denied. 

Regards,

Posighdun - Avicus Network Senior Moderator
